title: Al-Ma'arij as a whole: tadabbur and targets: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ma'arij as a whole rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 35. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: The Day: its length and terror
The exception: those who pray, and their qualities

arabic.text: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ (٢٢) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ (٢٣) وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ (٢٤) لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ (٢٥)

questions.q: In the portal response box, write a target linked to an ayah. Start: 'Because of 70:__, this week I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Because of 70:32, this week I will keep every promise I make.'

questions.q: Reflection (Forms long answer): explain how Al-Ma'arij moves from the Day, to human nature, to the qualities of the believers. Start: 'Al-Ma'arij begins with ...' Today's rota group finishes any outstanding checks.
questions.a: A paragraph covering the three movements with one cited ayah each.

questions.q: Extend: compare 70:19 to 21 with At-Takathur 102:1 to 2.
questions.a: Both show the human pull towards wealth; Al-Ma'arij gives the cure: prayer and charity.

questions.q: Which quality is mentioned at the start and end of the list (70:23 and 70:34)?
questions.a: A) Prayer. Constant in prayer (70:23) and maintaining prayer (70:34).

questions.q: Think again: If someone asked you 'what does Al-Ma'arij teach?', what would you answer in one sentence?
questions.a: The Day is certain; people are anxious by nature, except those whose prayer, charity, honesty and trust keep them steady.
